name: handbook
description: A documentation and knowledge-base theme. Sections and articles are numbered like a manual, so every page has an address: see 2.3.

color_scheme.description: Where every reader starts. Each can switch with the light/dark button.

sections.description: Tag slugs of your sections, in order, separated by commas. Empty shows every tag.

hero_heading.description: Homepage heading. Defaults to "How can we help?".

hero_image.description: Replaces the Handbook cover artwork on the homepage.

support_url.description: Where readers get help: a contact page or email link. Empty hides support links.

show_recent.description: Lists recently updated articles on the homepage.

show_signup.description: Shows an email signup for product updates above the footer.

show_feedback.description: Asks "Was this page helpful?" at the end of each article.
